With the coming into operation of the Jammu & Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019, one of the Acts which came to suffer repeal is the Jammu & Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 whereas Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 came to be applicable in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir as well as in the Union Territory of Ladakh for the purpose of effecting of acquisition of private property/land of the residents of Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir and Union Territory of Ladakh intended for land acquisition for industrialization, development of infrastructure facilities and urbanization.
